question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
-- Final result with rounded values
WITH region_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        wr.name AS region_name,
        COUNT(wo.id) AS num_orders,
        SUM(wo.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
    FROM web_orders wo
    JOIN web_accounts wa ON wo.account_id = wa.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps wsr ON wa.sales_rep_id = wsr.id
    JOIN web_region wr ON wsr.region_id = wr.id
    GROUP BY wr.name
),
rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        wr.name AS region_name,
        wsr.name AS sales_rep_name,
        SUM(wo.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total_sales
    FROM web_orders wo
    JOIN web_accounts wa ON wo.account_id = wa.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps wsr ON wa.sales_rep_id = wsr.id
    JOIN web_region wr ON wsr.region_id = wr.id
    GROUP BY wr.name, wsr.name
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        sales_rep_name,
        rep_total_sales,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY rep_total_sales DESC) AS drnk
    FROM rep_sales
)
SELECT 
    rs.region_name,
    rs.num_orders,
    ROUND(rs.total_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
    tr.sales_rep_name,
    ROUND(tr.rep_total_sales, 2) AS sales_rep_total_sales
FROM region_summary rs
JOIN top_reps tr ON rs.region_name = tr.region_name
WHERE tr.drnk = 1
ORDER BY rs.region_name;
